description: An analogue-style oscillator with five waveform outputs, linear and exponential frequency modulation and a voltage-controlled pulse width

params.text: Sets the frequency across the octave picked by the range switch, marked -5 to +5
Picks the octave the frequency knob works in: LOW, 32 foot, 16 foot, 8 foot, 4 foot or 2 foot
Attenuates the linear frequency input before it reaches the oscillator
Attenuates the pulse width input before it reaches the pulse shaper
Sets the width of the pulse wave
Attenuates the adjustable exponential input before it reaches the oscillator

inputs.text: A rising edge here restarts the oscillator's cycle
Modulates the frequency linearly, scaled by the level knob beside it
Modulates the pulse width, scaled by the level knob beside it
Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, added to whatever the other pitch jacks carry
Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, scaled by the level knob beside it

outputs.text: The ramp wave, which runs the opposite way to the saw
The pulse wave at the width set on the panel
